analysis:
Both units are base_text excerpts of docs/developer/test.md (base lines 868-1322 and 1323-1750). No patch hunks or head text were supplied, so the actual PR change to this file is not visible. The file is test-procedure documentation, not runtime code, and I found no security-relevant behavior in these base excerpts. Items relevant to threat IDs that a later pass should confirm are unchanged:
- Lines 884 and 1301-1303 cover App Attest build qualification, revocation, shadow validation and the live-Mac qualification caveat. They are consistent with T-052, T-053, T-054 and T-058.
- The doc says CI green or a simulated provider does not substitute for signed-Mac/Apple qualification (lines 976-978, 884). Any head edit that weakens this wording could invalidate T-052/T-054 assumptions.
- Lines 1576-1599 require disposable DATABASE_URLs for destructive store tests. This matters for A-009, the payment ledger, and A-015.
- Withdrawal and payout tests at line 1335 map to T-030 and T-060.
- Cache-scope and SSD tests (lines 1233-1259, 1305-1321) map to T-041/SEC-035. They say tests do not qualify signed persistence or multi-host routing.
No cross-file interactions can be assessed without the diff. A diff-based pass should check whether the PR removes or weakens the 'disposable database' warnings or the 'does not qualify production trust' disclaimers.
